decisions.briefing: Markets edged higher today with NASDAQ +0.8% and S&P 500 +0.7%, a mild risk-on tone. With 3 open slots and cash above the deployment threshold, we bought INIO, VSAT, and MRCY — all showing full four-signal momentum confirmation (RSI, MACD, SMA-20, volume) — while holding the existing 7 positions unchanged.

market_education.summary_en: Equities drifted modestly higher today, with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500 slightly, suggesting continued but not aggressive risk appetite among investors. There was no major macro catalyst reported in available data today, consistent with a steady grind-up rather than a sharp rally. Broad participation across sectors, as seen in diverse momentum candidates, points to a healthy if unspectacular advance.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和上揚，納斯達克指數升0.8%，標普500指數升0.7%，反映市場風險偏好持續但未見強勁爆發。暫時未見重大宏觀消息刺激，走勢較似穩步爬升而非急漲。從多個不同行業均出現動能買盤訊號來看，今日升勢屬於較健康及廣泛的格局。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple independent signals — like RSI in a healthy range, a MACD crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — to all align before buying. Relying on just one signal can give false alarms, but when several agree, it's a stronger sign that real buying interest is behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前，等待多個獨立訊號同時出現，例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於移動平均線，以及成交量放大。只靠單一訊號容易出現假訊號，但當多個指標同時指向同一方向時，就更能確認背後有真實的買盤支持。
